content: Playwright 1.61 assertions verified: expect(page).toHaveTitle(string|RegExp) (auto-retrying, v1.20+), expect(locator).toBeFocused() (v1.20+), expect(page).toHaveURL(string|RegExp|predicate). All supported on chromium/firefox/webkit projects. No first-class page-level activeElement assertion - use locator.toBeFocused() or page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement). Sufficient vocabulary for NAV-04 title+focus e2e across the 3-engine matrix.
